scope: Previously observed author-labeled regression. Not independent evaluation, legal accuracy, or user outcomes.
latency_scope: Warm model local CPU; includes query encoding; baseline runs first; no HTTP/database.

How should the controller assess an appropriate level of security of processing?

How do recipients submit sufficiently precise and adequately substantiated notices of illegal content?
What explanation must a statement of reasons provide when content is restricted?
How long should access to the internal complaint-handling system be available?

How should advertisements identify the person on whose behalf the advertisement is presented?
Which main parameters used in recommender systems must be explained?
What privacy safety and security protections apply to minors on online platforms?
Which thresholds are used in the designation of gatekeepers?
What basic functionalities of number-independent interpersonal communications services must be interoperable?
What should providers consider for AI literacy of staff?
How is a risk management system established for high-risk AI systems?
What measures enable natural persons to oversee high-risk AI systems?
What disclosure requirements concern deep fakes and artificially generated content?
Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority
Designing online interfaces to deceive manipulate or impair free informed decisions
